how: the elementary part holds: a disc of fixed physical radius in a metric of fixed physical area has coordinate radius eps_phys sqrt(Im tau/A_phys), and putting L = -log(eps_coord) into L + (1/2) log Im tau cancels the half-logarithm, leaving a modular-invariant scale; and, as the note itself says, this fixes the invariant coordinate of the end's scale and does not remove the scale (B1921, B1927). That both terms 'acquire an operator-theoretic origin' in the lane's six-dimensional cusp action is the lane's identification, in its own upstream model, not checked by main
